text:
4. 2. 1. 

Pāsāṇasuttaṃ. 

147. Evaṃ me sutaṃ: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate. Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ ajjhokāse nisinno hoti. Devo ca ekamekaṃ phusāyati. 

Atha kho māro pāpimā bhagavato bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetukāmo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato avidūre mahante mahante pāsāṇe padolesi

Atha kho bhagavā māro ayaṃ pāpimā iti viditvā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:

Sacemaṃ kevalaṃ sabbaṃ gijjhakūṭaṃ caleyyasi, 5

Neva sammā vimuttānaṃ buddhānaṃ atthi iñjitanti. 

Atha kho māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ bhagavā, jānāti maṃ sugatoti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.
